value.value: Normal spinel ZnAl2O4 has Fd-3m symmetry with oxygen 32e, tetrahedral Zn 8a and octahedral Al 16d. Figure 1 contrasts tetrahedral ZnO in P63mc and octahedral AlOOH in Cmcm. These are literature structural depictions, not measured new source coordinates.

value.value: High M/OH (lower pH) favors octahedral Zn monomers; their recoordination may limit tetrahedral-Zn spinel nucleation and permit AlOOH formation. Low M/OH (higher pH) favors ZnO as a tetrahedral-Zn reservoir, with dissolution feeding spinel and residual ZnO as impurity. This is an author mechanism, not directly measured rates or resolved molecular intermediates.

Qualitative high/low pH descriptions must not become numerical pH values; the separately reported D3 pH 5.5 remains specific to that solution.
